in_sanskrit.name: Jetharam
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है God Rama's vehicle
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Jetharam एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Jetharam is a name derived from the Sanskrit language, originating in Hindu mythology. It is believed to represent the divine chariot of Lord Rama, a revered deity in Hinduism. The name is a combination of 'Jeta' (vehicle) and 'Rama' (God).
